title: Download a DAW set from the Score view locally
description:
As a producer, I want a Download for your DAW button on the Score view, so that I can finish the piece in the DAW without leaving the app.

```gherkin
Feature: Download a DAW set from the web app
  Scenario: Download a score that compiles
    Given the web app is open on the score "march-blues" and every sample it uses is in the library
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then the browser receives a zip named "March Blues Project.zip"
    And the zip holds "March Blues Project/March Blues.als" and a "Samples/Imported" folder with every sample the score uses
    And the set file is byte-identical to the one "apricity export --daw-set" writes for the same score and samples

  Scenario: A score that does not compile offers no download
    Given the score has an error at line 7 column 3
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then no download starts
    And the error is shown with its line and column
```
